faqs.a:
Section 3002.10. Handrails,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
3002.10. Handrails.
A handrail shall be provided on one wall of the car, preferably the rear. The rails
                  shall be smooth and the inside surface at least 1 1/2 inches (38 mm) clear of the
                  walls at a nominal height of 32 inches (813 mm) from the floor. Nominal = +1 inch
                  (25 mm).
Note:
Thirty-two inches (813 mm) required to reduce interference with car controls where
                  lowest button is centered at 35 inches (889 mm) above floor."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 5, 9-14-2020)
